item.title: HS Wrestling Wrap: Hightstown tunes up for sectionals with win over Peddie
item.description: Hoping to reach its first sectional final in school history next week, the Hightstown High wrestling team tuned up by blasting Peddie, 54-23, on Wednesday. It was an upper weight blitz as the Rams got pins from Jose Vega (150), Antonio Arroyo (165), Jaiker Fabian-Valle (175), Jacob Kramer (190) and Aiden Lu (215).
